## Review Checklist (for reviewers)
- [ ] Content accuracy — all facts and claims verified
- [ ] Brand alignment — tone, visuals, messaging on-brand
- [ ] Legal clearance — no IP issues, releases signed, disclaimers present
- [ ] Audio quality — clear dialogue, appropriate music levels
- [ ] Visual quality — color, framing, graphics all polished
- [ ] Duration — within target length
- [ ] Call to action — correct links, handles, promotions
